review_evidence: Reviewed the complete 388-primary-file LeanCert unit by source inventory and declaration scan. It contains certified interval, dyadic, transcendental, optimization, root-finding and analytic-number-theory developments together with their correctness theorems.

The hydrated source contains 5,425 definition/theorem/lemma/structure/class/instance-style declarations; representative engine modules pair executable certified procedures with formal correctness statements.
Benchmark and API files are interwoven with reusable certified interfaces and theorem-bearing components, so no content-level lossless hard-exclusion class was established for this unit.
summary: Reviewed LeanCert as a large theorem-bearing certified-analysis and numerical-verification development; the complete primary unit remains retained.

review_evidence: Declaration grep over all 195 files: 3334 declaration lines; zero-count files are only LeanCert/Analysis/DBN.lean, LeanCert/QProduct.lean, LeanCert/Validity.lean, Tests/AxiomAudit.lean, Tests/TrustManifest.lean.
Read LeanCert/Analysis/DBN.lean completely: 16 imports of LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.* and a docstring about the de Bruijn-Newman threshold certificate; pure import aggregator, retained under FILTER-007.
Read LeanCert/QProduct.lean completely: 8 imports of LeanCert.QProduct.* and a docstring on certified q-product integrals; pure import aggregator, retained under FILTER-007.

Read LeanCert/Validity.lean completely: 17 imports of LeanCert.Validity.* and a docstring naming the Bool-to-Prop Golden Theorems (verify_upper_bound, VerifiedGlobalMin, Krawczyk, Bezout certificates); retained under FILTER-007.

Read head and command profile of Tests/AxiomAudit.lean: 57 assert_no_sorry and 45 #guard_msgs in #print axioms blocks pinning axiom sets of flagship theorems; retained because it records the verified-theorem interface and no auxiliary channel was verified.

Read head and command profile of Tests/TrustManifest.lean: 94 #assert_trust lines classifying exported theorems (e.g. LeanCert.Validity.verify_upper_bound) by trust class; retained for the same reason.
Read LeanCert/Analysis/HadamardSupport/Analysis/Complex/BorelCaratheodory.lean completely: public theorem Complex.borelCaratheodory_zero_closedBall with full proof.
Read LeanCertMathlibPin.lean completely: def expectedMathlibCommit plus docstring; a small declaration-bearing module, retained.
LeanCert.lean (22154 bytes): 97 imports plus namespace LeanCert with export commands re-exporting the core API (Expr, IntervalRat, checkRatInterval, verify_rat_*), so it is not a pure import file.

Large files such as LeanCert/Core/IntervalRat/Taylor.lean (103207 bytes, 55 theorem lines), LeanCert/Tactic/LeanCert/Router.lean, LeanCert/Engine/TaylorModel/*.lean and LeanCert/Validity/Bounds.lean are theorem/def-bearing certified-analysis content.
LeanCert/Test/*.lean and LeanCert/Examples/*.lean each contain at least one example/theorem/def declaration by the grep.
summary: Surveyed all 195 listed files of alerad__leancert (sizes from the brief, directory layout, lakefile.toml at the root). A per-file grep for Lean declaration keywords (theorem, lemma, def, structure, class, instance, inductive, abbrev, example, axiom, opaque, syntax/macro/elab, with public/private/noncomputable/meta modifiers) found 3334 declaration lines in total; 190 files have at least one declaration. The 5 files with none were read: LeanCert/Analysis/DBN.lean, LeanCert/QProduct.lean and LeanCert/Validity.lean are pure import aggregators with module docstrings, which FILTER-007 keeps primary-eligible because no auxiliary query channel was verified; Tests/AxiomAudit.lean and Tests/TrustManifest.lean hold #print axioms / assert_no_sorry / #assert_trust commands that name about 100 exported theorems and document the trust interface, so no content-level invariant under FILTER-004 establishes that nothing searchable is lost. Every file is retained.
